from itertools import permutations

# Define the size of the grid
n = 7

# Fixed assignment
fixed_assignment = {1: 1}

# Function to check if a permutation is a Costas array
def is_costas_array(p):
    # Create a set to store the displacement vectors
    displacement_vectors = set()
    
    # Iterate over the columns
    for c1 in range(n):
        for c2 in range(c1 + 1, n):
            # Calculate the displacement vector
            dr = p[c1] - p[c2]
            dc = c1 - c2
            
            # If the displacement vector is already in the set, return False
            if (dr, dc) in displacement_vectors:
                return False
            
            # Add the displacement vector to the set
            displacement_vectors.add((dr, dc))
    
    # If no duplicate displacement vectors were found, return True
    return True

# Find a Costas array consistent with the fixed assignment
for p in permutations(range(n)):
    # Check if the permutation satisfies the fixed assignment
    if all(p[c] == fixed_assignment[c] for c in fixed_assignment):
        # Check if the permutation is a Costas array
        if is_costas_array(p):
            # Print the solution
            print(p)
            break
else:
    # If no solution was found, print "UNSATISFIABLE"
    print("UNSATISFIABLE")
